title: Add resilient invoice export
summary: Introduce a queued CSV export that reuses the existing job and storage abstractions.
objective: Let administrators request large invoice exports without holding an HTTP request open.

successCriteria.check: Drive the request through the worker and download the CSV
Force storage failure and observe retry state

design.heading: Job boundary
design.body: Persist an export request, enqueue its identifier, and let the worker stream rows to existing object storage.

files.reason: This is the existing authenticated entry point

failureHandling: Use the worker retry policy for transient storage errors
verification: Run focused unit and integration tests
Drive one export end to end
rollout: Ship behind the existing export feature flag
assumptions: The current object store supports multipart uploads

openDecisions.question: How long should downloads remain available?
